detail.body:
Updates the requirements on [peft](https://github.com/huggingface/peft) to permit the latest version.
Release notes

Sourced from peft's releases.

v0.21.2

This is a PEFT release fixes an issue that prevented encoder-decoder models to work when using Transformers ≥ 5.18.0.

Changes:

  • #3845
Commits
  • eaa35c7 Patch release v0.21.2 changes (#3855)
  • c9e7474 Patch release v0.21.1 changes (#3833)
  • 9dc6fa2 Release: 0.21.0 (#3748)
  • 20feaa7 FIX Loading scalar adapter state entries (#3699)
  • c9185a3 ENH Warn about unused rank / alpha pattern keys (#3588)
  • 578142b DOC Fix multiple typos, wrong arguments and links (#3687)
  • 6aa4944 Method comparison: Add UniLoRA benchmark to image-gen (#3740)
  • b3d183f Mixed model: Delete every auxiliary adapter and resolve the remaining active ...
  • e99fdd2 FIX Forward autocast_adapter_dtype on all PeftModel subclasses (#3668)
  • a5e4c58 ENH Reject MiSS and PSOFT invalid ranks (#3708)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

Streamline your workflow and let CLA assistant handle the legal side of contributions to a repository for you. CLA assistant enables contributors to sign CLAs from within a pull request.

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
